# Interview Sarthi

> InterviewSarthi is three apps for job seekers, plus MeetingSarthi (October 2026) for client calls at work: Apply Sarthi finds jobs and helps fill applications (always free), Prep Sarthi runs spoken mock interviews from your CV (free 7-minute demo, no sign-up, works on a phone), and Live Sarthi shows answer suggestions during interview calls on Windows (30 minutes free). The homepage at https://interviewsarthi.com/ explains all three. Paid passes are one-time and never renew. Prices are given in rupees for India and in US dollars for everyone else. Built and run by Abhishek Choudhary. Facts reviewed 2 October 2026.

Product and guide pages contain readable HTML. Interactive app features require JavaScript. Facts pages carry review dates and a corrections address.

## The three products

- [Apply Sarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/apply/): Web app at https://apply.interviewsarthi.com/ plus a Chrome extension. Brings together jobs from Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Foundit, Shine, Internshala and company career pages, matches them to your CV, tailors your CV for a job and fills supported application forms for you to review and submit. Always free, with no paid plan. Browsing jobs and your first tailored CV need no Gemini key; further tailoring uses your own free key. Best for: finding jobs worldwide (India first) that fit your CV.
- [Prep Sarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/prep/): Web app for phones and computers, at https://interviewsarthi.com/prep/app/. An AI interviewer asks spoken questions built from your CV and the job you want, follows up on weak answers, and writes a report with a score, what was missing and a stronger answer for each question. Free 7-minute demo interview with no sign-up and no key. Then one 30-day pass: Rs 99 (USD 9.99), unlimited mock interviews, paid once, never renews; after buying, you add your own free Google Gemini key in a one-minute setup. Invite friends: a friend who buys through your link gets 37 days on their first pass and you get 7 free days (give a week, get a week). Company practice pages: TCS NQT, Infosys, Cognizant GenC, Capgemini. Best for: rehearsing out loud before a real interview.
- [MeetingSarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/meeting/): New in October 2026, for people at work rather than job seekers. A Windows app that keeps a per-project log (typed or spoken notes; read-only feeders from a local git folder, GitHub and Jira Cloud), listens to the client's side of a work call and shows a one-or-two-sentence reply grounded in confirmed log entries, with the entry it came from; after the call it drafts the recap, action items and a follow-up message for the user to confirm. No bot joins the meeting; audio goes to Google Gemini on the user's own free key; the log stays on the laptop. 30 minutes of live replies free per computer; projects, notes, feeders and the Ask junior free with no limit; then a Month Pass, Rs 99 for 30 days on two computers, paid once, never renews. India only at launch; the Windows installer is announced to a waitlist on the page. A MeetingSarthi key does not open Interview Sarthi, nor the other way round.
- [Live Sarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/live/): The Interview Sarthi Windows app (Windows 10 version 2004 or later, Windows 11), from the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NMKQPSQ1KS8. It hears interview questions on Teams, Zoom, Google Meet and other call apps and drafts answer suggestions from your CV, in English, Hindi or Hinglish. Its panel is hidden from supported screen sharing. Answers start in about 1.5 seconds; timing varies. Uses your own free Gemini key. 30 minutes free per device, then one-time passes: 2 days Rs 99 (USD 9.99), 30 days on 2 devices Rs 299 (USD 29.99). A pass's days start when you activate its key, not when you pay; 7-day money-back on a first pass. Refer a friend: when a friend buys a pass with your invite code and activates it, you both get a Free Interview Day (24 hours on one computer, starting when you activate it). Use assistance only where interview rules permit it.

- [Resume-based mock interview walkthrough](https://interviewsarthi.com/prep/mock-interview-from-resume.html): CV and job-description setup, spoken practice and how to use feedback.
- [Public job directory](https://apply.interviewsarthi.com/jobs): job details, company pages and role categories; availability changes as employers update listings.
